strategy.primary: Make Gwendlyn a repeatable random-discard engine: haste her, then untap her (Pemmin's Aura, Minamo, Magewright's Stone, Patriar's Seal) and copy her ability (Illusionist's Bracers) to strip hands while discard punishers (Waste Not, Liliana's Caress, Geth's Grimoire, Tinybones) pay off.
strategy.secondary: Wheels refill opposing hands to strip again and punish draws (Sheoldred, Bowmasters, Underworld Dreams); Chains, Notion Thief and Opposition Agent deny resources; Breach + LED + Wheel of Fortune as a compact finish.
